name: Rope Pull
disable: DC 20 Thievery check (trained) to tie off the rope to a more solid support

items.name: Boulders from Above
items.text:
Trigger A Small or larger creature or equivalent weight pulls on the rope

---
Effect All creatures within the pit or adjacent to the pit take 4d6+10 bludgeoning damage (DC 23 basic Reflex save save) from falling rocks dislodged from above.

text: This trap appears to be an obvious 10-foot-deep pit with angled walls to prevent easy escape, but the true danger is represented not by the hole in the ground but from a set of loose stones in the ceiling. A knotted rope hangs from a beam above, seemingly to provide an option to swing across the pit, but any weight on the rope pulls down large, heavy boulders stacked far above.
